messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — pushing a small patch bump 0.15.2 to fix an auth header regression (x-rw-auth dropped when proxied). Need coordinated bumps across api, runtime, console, sdk. Cutoff: EOD PST tomorrow.

PRs: api #4213, runtime #708, console #1293, sdk-python #214. Planning light canary in staging-west first.

maria: Ack — I'll start code review on api #4213 today, targeting approvals before cutoff.

devon: Runtime needs a tiny kv-cache handshake tweak coupled with header passthrough. I've got a branch, but need a runtime owner review (ping @sophia).

sophia: On it — will review runtime #708 tonight. Any migration or config flags to be aware of?

alex: No DB migrations or flags. It's just header pass-through + tests. Please add a `chore(release): bump 0.15.2` commit message in each repo once merged.

tanvi: FYI console e2e is failing on staging due to CORS with the new header, I'll open a tiny follow-up fix if needed (might be #1294).

ci-bot: CI status: api #4213 — ✅ all green; runtime #708 — ❗ flaky test failure on nightly; console #1293 — ❌ e2e failing; sdk-python #214 — ✅ green.

devon: Re-ran runtime CI after a small fix for the flaky test, pushed branch update.

alex: Canary plan: deploy api+runtime+console+sdk to staging-west (2 instances) for 30m smoke, then staging-east, then prod canary. Deploy window suggested: 03:00-05:00 UTC. Please tag PRs with `deploy-window:03:00-05:00`.

maria: I'll coordinate console + sdk cut during that window and watch the dashboards. Tagging owners on the PRs. :eyes: 

sophia: Runtime review done — LGTM, approving #708.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to staging-west (api,runtime,console,sdk). Initial smoke OK for 15m, continuing monitoring.

tanvi: Console e2e fix landed in #1294, merging now. Should flip console green.

alex: Example changelog entry to copy into each repo's CHANGELOG.md:

```
Fix: preserve x-rw-auth on proxied requests (0.15.2)
- Prevents header loss when requests are proxied through edge/router
```

maria: Updated console and sdk changelogs (sdk-python #217 has the entry).

devon: Runtime patched and merged, created tag `v0.15.2`.

alex: Awesome — once api and console are merged, we'll do the staging canary window. Last sanity check: anyone seeing test regressions besides the e2e CORS one?

maria: None on api. All unit/integration green.

tanvi: Console e2e passed after the fix, merging to main.

alex: Great work all — marking release tasks done on the board. If anything blocks the cutoff, drop a quick note here. :thumbsup:
